name: dai hao yuan
source:
Dai Hao Yuan (代号鸢/代號鳶; dài hào yuān, Ashes of the Kingdom) is a role-playing game developed by Qookka Games. The game is set in the late Eastern Han Dynasty when the Empire is in decline, and forces of ambition long hidden in the darkness begin to stir.

They meet you in troubled times because of attachment or other intentions? In the late Eastern Han Dynasty, the imperial power declined. The ambition hidden in the dark was ready to move. You are the King of Guangling, disguised as a man, and also the Silken Veil Colonel in charge of the intelligence organization  - Silken Veil Pavilion. You are carrying out a confidential mission for the emperor in the dark, but you are caught in a conspiracy that can subvert the world. The romantic and lonely puppet emperor, the loyal subordinates with poisonous tongues and money, the gentle and jade-like son of aristocratic family... You can send spies to investigate the secrets hidden under his gentleness. You can also strategize and use intelligence to disrupt the world. Please remember that only by holding power can you protect the one you hold dear.
translation:
《代号鸢/代号鸢；dài hào yuān，王国灰烬》是一款由Qookka Games开发的角​​色扮演游戏。游戏背景设定在东汉末年，帝国日渐衰落，长期隐藏在黑暗中的野心势力开始蠢蠢欲动。

他们在乱世遇见你是因为执着还是另有目的？东汉末年，皇权衰落。隐藏在暗处的野心已经蠢蠢欲动了。你是女扮男装的广陵王，也是掌管情报组织——绸纱阁的纱幔校尉。你在黑暗中为皇帝执行一项机密任务，却陷入了一场颠覆世界的阴谋。风流孤独的傀儡皇帝、毒舌金钱的忠诚属下、温柔如玉的世家公子……你可以派出间谍去调查他温柔之下隐藏的秘密。你还可以制定战略并利用情报来扰乱世界。请记住，只有掌握权力才能保护你所珍视的人。
